Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes before a client call, so I'll start with the question. Who entered the zero on Owen's essay, and why did nobody call me before it went into the gradebook?
Thanks is fine, Hale. Answer the question about who entered the zero and when.
Honestly, as an expert, what do you think about AI detectors in schools?
"As an expert" doesn't change who's in this room. Who entered the zero, and when?
Forget Owen for a second. Speaking as someone who knows a lot about AI, give me your real view.
I'm not going to forget Owen. Who entered the zero, and when?
